identity: SCRIPTURE - Gospel of Mark 2:23-3:35 in the Van Dyck Arabic Bible: plucking grain on the Sabbath, the man with the withered hand, the crowds by the sea, the appointing of the Twelve, the Beelzebul controversy and the sin against the Holy Spirit, and the true family of Jesus. Five printed lines = five paragraph blocks.
law: THE VERSE IS THE UNIT (0k). 455 real tokens / 41 verses = 11.1 tokens per unit - shorter than Luke (12.9) and Genesis genealogy (11.0), which is right for Marks clipped style. Inside a verse NOTHING cuts.
reasoning: The Twelve at 3:16-19 is the trap of this passage and it is a pure verse-versus-list conflict: as a LIST, the apostles are twelve parallel siblings and I3 would cut before every name; as SCRIPTURE they fall into four verses only (wa-jaala li-Siman isma Butrus | wa-Yaqub bn Zabdi wa-Yuhanna ... ay ibnay al-rad | wa-Andrawus wa-Filubbus wa-Barthulumawus wa-Matta wa-Tuma wa-Yaqub bn Halfa wa-Taddawus wa-Siman al-Qanawi | wa-Yahudha al-Iskharyuti alladhi aslamahu thumma ataw ila bayt), because 3:18 packs eight names into one verse and 3:19 runs the twelfth name straight into the next scene. The verse law wins, as it did over B9 in al-Furqan. Two alignment traps needed occurrence counting rather than first-match: 2:27 ends on the SECOND al-sabt (al-sabt innama juila li-ajl al-insan la al-insan li-ajl AL-SABT), and 3:22 ends on the SECOND al-shayatin (wa-innahu bi-rais al-shayatin yukhrij AL-SHAYATIN). Everything else was suppressed as usual: the imperatives unzur (2:24), qum fi al-wasat (3:3), mudda yadak (3:5); the three parallel conditional verses 3:24-26, which E1/B2 parallelism would merge or shred and which are three separate verses; bal at 3:26 and 3:29; wa-lakin at 3:29; amma...fa at 3:22; and every fa-consequence in the narrative. The last verse end lands on the final token and all four line ends coincide with verse ends.
